name: AWS
description: The AWS CLI/SDK profile from ~/.aws/config. AWS has no machine-wide switch (it's the AWS_PROFILE variable), so pick it per profile; servers get AWS_PROFILE, which the AWS CLI and every AWS SDK read.

sso-login.label: Sign in with SSO
sso-login.description: Runs `aws sso login` for a profile; finish in the browser window that opens.
